summary: Retest after iter 69 fixes — avatar narration in BroadcastFeed. Critical ReferenceError (missing useState/useRef declarations) is now committed in source (lines 156 + 169) and dashboard renders cleanly with no ErrorBoundary fallback. narrationLineFor rewrite verified against live deal-lane events: spoken text matches the new cinematic format. Mute, toggle, MutationObserver-tracked narrating transitions, and avatar wiring all pass.

ui_bugs.issue: When backend live-pulse summary contains an em-dash placeholder for the company (e.g. `Deal created · $30,000 → —`), `_extractName` returns `"—"` and the spoken line becomes `"Deal closed with —, value $30,000."`. Observed 2/5 deal narrations during this run. Suggest filtering placeholder names (em-dash, empty) and falling back to `Deal closed, value $30,000.`.

critical_code_review_comments: Iter 69 fix is correctly committed: BroadcastFeed.jsx line 156 declares `const [narrating, setNarrating] = useState(false);` and line 169 declares `const narrateTimerRef = useRef(null);`. No ReferenceError observed.
narrationLineFor now composes from event fields (`_extractName` + `_extractValue`) instead of regex-rewriting the visual summary — much cleaner and matches the spec for all four narrated lanes.
Speech override resilience: `speakLine` cancels in-flight before speaking, and the unmount/mute/disable effects all call `synth.cancel()` — correct lifecycle handling.

success_rate.frontend: 100% on retest scope (deal lane verified live; hot/reply/scheduling verified via code audit since live-pulse emitted no events for those lanes during the 55s window)

context_for_next_testing_agent: Iter 69 critical ReferenceError fix is committed (BroadcastFeed.jsx lines 156, 169). narrationLineFor now matches spec for all 4 narrated lanes. To re-verify hot/reply/scheduling against live events you may need to seed those event types via /api/ops/outbound/live-pulse or simulate, since the live data during this run only emitted deal events. The headless speak override pattern (window.add_init_script with a synthetic onend timeout) is required because the real Web Speech API is a no-op in headless Chromium.
rca of the issue: Iter 69 fixes verified end-to-end. (1) Missing `narrating` useState + `narrateTimerRef` useRef now declared at lines 156 and 169 — dashboard renders without ErrorBoundary fallback. (2) `narrationLineFor` rewritten to compose from event fields: deal-lane spoken output is now 'Deal closed with <name>, value <$value>.' instead of the broken 'Deal closed. created , $30,000 for Realtor T'. Confirmed against 5 live deal events. Remaining cosmetic issue: when backend summary uses an em-dash placeholder for the company name, the spoken line includes '—' as the name; suggest filtering placeholders in _extractName.
